gitCommit.subject: [Canvas] 圖層圖片命名功能 (#1458)
gitCommit.body:
[Canvas] 圖層圖片命名功能 (#1458)

* feat(canvas): add image layer naming in layers panel

Allow users to double-click image layer names in the layers panel to
rename them inline. Names are persisted via the existing undo/redo
history system.

- Add optional `name` field to ImageObject type
- Display custom name with i18n fallback in layer panel
- Add inline edit UI (Enter to confirm, Escape to cancel, blur to commit)
- Include image name in canvas object hash for proper undo/redo tracking
- Add 'Changed Image Name' to HistoryAction type union

* fix(canvas): prevent double-fire on rename commit and fix useCallback deps

- Add isCommittingRef guard to prevent commitRename from firing twice
  when Enter key triggers commit and subsequent input unmount fires blur
- Remove unnecessary `object` from getObjectName useCallback deps
  (function only uses the `obj` parameter, not the closure variable)

* fix(test): use valid HistoryAction type in image layer naming test

Change 'Initial' to 'Initial State' to match the HistoryAction union type.

* feat(canvas): extend layer naming to video objects

Apply the same inline rename capability from image layers to video
objects — double-click to rename, Enter/Escape/blur to commit/cancel,
with full undo/redo support via 'Changed Video Name' history action.

* fix(canvas): resolve review issues in layer rename flow

- Determine actionType before entering .map() updater to avoid
  closure mutation and silent wrong action type on missing objects
- Always exit rename mode (setIsRenaming false) before guard checks
  so users never get stuck in the input field
- Replace requestAnimationFrame with queueMicrotask for the
  double-fire guard, matching the actual timing requirement

* fix(canvas): restore type guard in handleNameChange to fix TS build

The simplified .map() spread `name: undefined` onto all object types,
which is incompatible with FrameObject.name (required string). Restore
the image/video type guard inside .map() while keeping actionType
determination outside.

---------

Co-authored-by: Kaipo Chen <kapoo1933@gmail.com>
